user.title: Connect Tuya Cloud project
user.description: Only Access ID, Access Secret and region are required. No Smart Life account and no app password.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew Tuya access
reauth_confirm.description: The Tuya project could not be authenticated. Please enter the credentials again.

error.invalid_auth: Access ID, Access Secret or signature is invalid.

abort.already_configured: This Tuya project is already configured.

data.enable_shadow: Read charger data from the IoT Core thing shadow

api_not_authorized.title: Tuya API not authorized
api_not_authorized.description: The project is not allowed to call the device API. Enable it in the Tuya console under 'Service API → Add Authorization'.

iot_core_not_authorized.title: IoT Core not authorized
iot_core_not_authorized.description: The thing shadow API is not enabled for this project. Enable IoT Core in the Tuya console and authorize the cloud project.

command_not_authorized.title: Device command not allowed
command_not_authorized.description: Tuya rejected a device command (1106). Check the permissions of the cloud project.

region_mismatch.title: Wrong region
region_mismatch.description: No devices were found. Check the region of the Tuya project and whether an app account is linked.
